reason: A DSH visual customization plugin that discovers Wallpaper Engine content, renders supported wallpapers behind the interface, and provides configurable glass styling, filtering, playback effects, rotation, and local uploads.

summaries.zh: 将本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸显示为 DSH 界面背景，并提供液态玻璃样式、筛选、轮播、播放效果和自定义壁纸管理。
summaries.en: Displays local Wallpaper Engine wallpapers behind the DSH interface with configurable glass styling, filtering, rotation, playback effects, and custom wallpaper management.

capabilities: Reads local Wallpaper Engine library metadata and media files
Serves supported local media through plugin HTTP routes
Extracts static frames from supported Scene wallpaper textures
Accepts and removes user-selected local JPG, PNG, and MP4 uploads
Persists plugin settings and upload metadata on the host filesystem
Applies configurable wallpaper and glass-style visual changes to the DSH interface
